init.title: iDotMatrix options
init.description:
Home Assistant normally connects through the proxy with the strongest signal, but the strongest one can be unreliable. Pin a specific proxy if needed.

Gamma corrects colour for the panel: its LEDs are near-linear while images are sRGB, so uncorrected output looks washed out. 2.2 is the recommended default — lower it towards 1.0 for a brighter, flatter look, or raise it for richer, darker colour.
